subject: English
passage: Graphic novelist Alison Bechdel's groundbreaking memoir Fun Home, winner of the 2006 Eisner Award for Best Reality-Based Work, is composed of ______ narrator, Bechdel's own experiences growing up with her closeted father.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation: Choice D is the best answer. Nothing belongs to the "chapters" in the sentence, so it should not be possessive—just a simple plural noun. The narrator does belong to the memoir—it's the narrator of the memoir—so "memoir" needs to be a singular possessive noun.
